title: Where to donate clothes in Toronto
meta_description: Where to donate clothes in Toronto: which charities take them, what each does with them, what they refuse, and how to spot a business donation bin.
hub_blurb: Seven registered charities in Toronto take clothing, and they split into two kinds. New Circles, Evangel Hall Mission and Dress for Success hand your clothes to the person who needs them, free. Goodwill, the Salvation Army, Yonge Street Mission's Double Take and Diabetes Canada sell them and spend the proceeds. This guide gives each one's address, hours, what it will refuse at the door, and whether anybody will collect from your house. It also covers the donation bins: the City counted over 600 permitted boxes in its 2020 report on textile waste, about a third of them run by businesses, and the permit sticker is yellow for a charity and orange for a company.
